/sd:
📉 Smart Drawdown Explained

Smart Drawdown is a hybrid loss-limit system. It starts as a trailing drawdown and later becomes fixed once a certain profit level is reached.

How it works:

• The drawdown begins at 6% of the account’s starting balance.
• As your equity grows, the drawdown moves up with your profits, gradually reducing the maximum loss allowed.
• Once your account reaches 3% profit from the starting balance, the drawdown locks in permanently at 3% of the starting balance.

After this point, the drawdown no longer moves, even if you:
Make additional profits
Withdraw funds
Reset the account

💡 Simply put:
At the beginning, the drawdown trails your profits. After you reach 3% profit, it locks and becomes fixed, giving you a stable and permanent loss limit.

📖 For the full explanation, you can check the article here:
https://intercom.help/fundedsquad/en/articles/12309893-smart-drawdown

/tradingday:
A trading day is counted if you make one or more trades within a 24-hour period ⏰ (from 8 PM EST to 8 PM EST). To be considered valid, you must achieve a minimum of 0.5% profit by the end of the 24-hour period 📈.

Note: if you opened a trade on the previous day and closed it on the following day, it'll be counted towards the previous day.
/news:
📢 News Trading Policy

✅ Challenge Phases (Phase 1 & Phase 2):

News trading is fully allowed during the evaluation stages.

⚠️ Funded / Instant Accounts Rules

• Instant Accounts: Opening new trades is not allowed within a 10-minute window around red-folder news (5 minutes before and 5 minutes after).
• Challenge Funded Accounts: Opening new trades is not allowed within an 8-minute window around red-folder news (4 minutes before and 4 minutes after).

❗ Important: Opening a new trade during these restricted windows is not permitted.

💡 Additional Clarifications

• You are allowed to hold trades during news.
• If a trade closes within the restricted window, any profit from that trade will be removed.
• If a trade was opened at least 2 hours before the news event, both the trade and the profits remain valid, even if it closes during the restricted window.
